name: Extended Router & Custom Loss Layer Nodes

name: Python & Rust Code Tuning Adapter (r=16)

description: Pre-tuned LoRA rank-16 adapter trained for code generation. Plugs directly into TriuneTransformer query and value projections.

name: FineWeb Curated 10K Sample Dataset

name: Hugging Face Transformers & Accelerate Suite

name: SafeTensors Zero-Copy Weight Serializer

description: Fast, memory-mapped zero-copy tensor serialization for exporting and loading multi-billion parameter checkpoints safely.

name: Weights & Biases (WandB) Experiment Tracker
author: Weights & Biases
description: Real-time experiment logging, loss curve tracking, router exit telemetry, and hardware utilization monitoring.
